nodes.title: First end-to-end acceptance run through the real HTTP API (sign-up, brand, wallet top-up, template agent, stack choice with no default, publish and deploy via approvals, number rent and KYC, contact import with consent, campaign launch, dispatcher tick, signed runtime events, analysis, memory, funnel, invoice, opt-out): 11 of 17 steps pass, 0 fail, 6 marked todo with their exact cause.
nodes.method: node:test product/tests/e2e.test.ts against a throwaway Postgres 16; FakeRuntime and scripted LLM; 3 identical runs; full suite 261/267 with the 6 todos

nodes.title: No business can make a production call through the API yet: KYC never becomes verified (G8 kyc_lapsed) and, from 2026-11-17, no tool can declare A2P (G8 cli_undeclared).
nodes.closes_when: campaigns ships a carrier KYC status path (system/vp_success only) and number.a2p.declare (policy), and the e2e steps 3b/3d pass without the direct database write
nodes.mitigation: Campaigns builder asked (2026-10-21) for a carrier KYC status webhook/sync tool limited to system or vp_success actors, and a policy-class number.a2p.declare tool; until then no production dial is possible, which fails safe.

nodes.title: E2E findings F3-F7 routed to owners: per-contact attributes never reach the ticket (campaigns); deployment.split ignored by running campaigns (campaigns); funnel counts live dials as connected (calls); unstable opt-out suppression code (intake); parallel queries on one client (calls); memory's minor check reads contact.custom only (memory).
nodes.closes_when: every e2e todo step is a normal passing step and the full suite is green on CI
